The '''Pammant system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pammant/Legends|Pammant]].
